updates.body: We're currently investigating a Partial Service disruption of the Blik payment method that began at 17:12 UTC. This issue is external to Stripe and is causing increased error rates for transactions processed through the Blik payment method. We are actively monitoring the situation and will provide updates as more information becomes available.
